args.reason: The --dry-run item serves the inspection goal, but two DoD items add capability the PRD excludes by name: a persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log appended on every evaluation, and a merge-gate --explain timeline with --since and --format filters. The first PRD goal says historical storage and query features are outside this PRD. The Phase-1 claim that history is a natural extension of inspection contradicts that explicit exclusion. The DoD capability set is not a subset of the declared goals, so this is over-scope.
